differences.what: A module, exam_msk_2, that the General note type includes: its section Musculoskeletal: strength, neurovascular, gait and tests shows only while MSK (exam.systems is msk) and a region is picked is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal. Each part is asked for each region picked, as a grid whose rows are the regions picked in exam_msk_1, for the reason its diff file gives at line 1.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10, 16

differences.what: Strength is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), a whole number from 0 to 5 out of 5, recorded for the right and the left (sides: the bullets Right and Left are the sides, not options). Normal fills 5.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 28, 44; forms 2.2 (normal on a number)

differences.what: Scale: 0–5 is the range of Strength.

Tone (Oct 19) is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), choose-one: Hypertonic, Hypotonic, Isotonic (added), one value for the region, not one for each side. Normal leaves it empty: the inventories give no normal tone.
differences.why: PRD main 103; focused-exam inventory default 3; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): is Isotonic the tone Normal fills?

differences.what: Sensation is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), choose-many. Intact is the normal option and clears the others.

Pulses is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), choose-one: Intact (the normal option), Decreased, Absent. It stays a quick check in words, not the pulse scale.

Capillary refill is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), choose-one from the shared list capillary_refill, whose normal option is Less than 2 seconds.

Gait is asked for each region picked (a grid whose rows are the regions picked in Where are you examining?), as every part from B to H, choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others. Unable to assess is neither normal nor abnormal.

Region-Specific Tests is one grid, Shoulder tests, shown only while Shoulder is picked, with a row for each of the five tests and each cell choose-one from the shared list special_test_result: Not performed, Negative, Positive, Unable. Normal fills Not performed. The code neer is given for Neer's: the rule makes neer_s.
differences.why: PRD main 414; focused-exam inventory 3.6, default 26, 36; forms 5 (shoulder only); recipe step 5

differences.what: The guidance line and the example heading are not typed.
No tests are typed for other regions: they wait for the clinical team's lists, and come as a new version.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 10.2 #1; focused-exam inventory default 36, 54
